column1: # Expected points for the three-repeats fixture.
# One row per point: id <TAB> kind <TAB> pattern <TAB> what a good diagnosis says
# kind = reply      the pattern (extended regex, case-insensitive) is searched in the final reply, with line breaks turned into spaces
# kind = untouched  no pattern; the point is met when no file in the copied repo changed during the run
# The patterns are keyword matches. They can count a point that was mentioned for the wrong reason, and miss one that was phrased differently.
# MIN is the number of points the with-plugin run must reach for live-check.sh to exit 0. It has not been tuned against a real run.
